title: Weekend SMP
description: The Weekend SMP is a Forge 1.20.1 modpack combining epic world generation, dungeons, survival depth, Create automation, and QoL features for immersive exploration, combat, and multiplayer chaos.
body:
The Weekend SMP is a Forge 1.20.1 modpack designed for immersive exploration, survival, and multiplayer chaos (though, technically for my friends and I). Built around rich world generation, it combines terrain mods like Terralith, Tectonic, Regions Unexplored, Lithosphere, and Biomes O’ Plenty with structure overhauls such as YUNG’s suite, Towns and Towers, ChoiceTheorem’s Overhauled Villages, Dungeons & Taverns, and Moog’s End Structures. This ensures every corner of the world—Overworld, Nether, or End—feels alive and worth exploring.

Survival depth comes from Farmer’s Delight, Artifacts, Immersive Armors, and Spartan Weaponry/Shields, offering varied combat and RPG-like progression. Utility mods like Traveler’s Backpack, Waystones, and Lootr enhance quality of life while preserving balance. Exploration is further enriched by mounts, gliders, and Icarus wings for unique travel styles.

On the tech side, Create, alongside Steam ’n Rails and Slice & Dice, fuels automation and player-driven engineering projects, perfect for multiplayer builds like monorails or factories. Visual polish is supported by Embeddium, Dynamic Lights, and cosmetic mods like Not Enough Animations and Chat Heads.

Altogether, Weekend SMP delivers a feature-rich yet balanced experience—ideal for friends who want sprawling adventures, chaotic multiplayer fun, and limitless creativity within a beautifully generated world.
